get.description:
Retrieve logged activity for the account (**Meld-Account-Id**) over a date range, optionally narrowed to connections, a customer, or specific actions.

External customer IDs show the current value, cached for up to five minutes.

Search boundaries are rounded down to milliseconds after range validation.

Activity is retained for 30 days. A single request may span at most 31 days.

Only the filters listed here are supported; the former *transactionIds*, *requestId*, *eventType*, *serviceProviders*, *financialAccountIds* and related filters were removed and are rejected with a 400 naming the parameter.

See [here](https://docs.meld.io/docs/debugging-activity-log) for information on how to use the activity log and why.

parameters.name: Meld-Version
parameters.description: Dated API version to use for this request, e.g. `2026-02-03`.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
Start date/time of the date range.

ISO DateTime Format yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss e.g. '2021-02-15T10:30:00.000-08:00'

Time zone must match the time zone of the end date/time if also present.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description:
End date/time of the date range.

ISO DateTime Format yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss e.g. '2021-02-15T11:30:00.000-08:00'

Time zone must match the time zone of the start date/time if also present.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description:
Comma separated list of actions to include.

Only include activity for these actions. Unknown actions are rejected; retired actions are ignored.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
Only include activity for this customer.

The ***customerId*** and ***externalCustomerId*** fields cannot be used in the same request.

parameters.name: externalCustomerId
parameters.description:
Only include activity for this customer.

The ***customerId*** and ***externalCustomerId*** fields cannot be used in the same request.

parameters.name: connectionIds
parameters.description:
Comma separated list of connection ids to include (at most 20).

Only include activity for these connections.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Unique key corresponding to an activity's position in the paginated list of results -- used to indicate that only activity residing before this key will be retrieved.

Each activity carries a unique key. Reference [Pagination](https://docs.meld.io/docs/pagination)

The ***before*** and ***after*** fields cannot be used in the same request.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Unique key corresponding to an activity's position in the paginated list of results -- used to indicate that only activity residing after this key will be retrieved.

Each activity carries a unique key. Reference [Pagination](https://docs.meld.io/docs/pagination)

The ***before*** and ***after*** fields cannot be used in the same request.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Limits number of returned activity.

*Default value*: 10

*Minimum value*: 1

*Maximum value*: 100

remaining.description: Lower bound on the number of activities remaining before/after this page, depending on the direction this page was selected. It is at least this many; a non-zero value means another page exists. Use the last activity's key with [before] for older results, or the first activity's key with [after] for newer results.
